notes.title: Our new game 'Goalgetter' is now released!
notes.notes:
We believe that fans of the Hockey Manager will also find great joy in playing 'Goalgetter'.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676860

'Goalgetter' is a comprehensive football career simulator that allows you to fulfill your dream of becoming a top striker in one of the major European leagues. As a young and talented striker, you can secure your place through intense training or other means, all while managing your personal life decisions, financial investments, and career choices.

notes.title: Hockey Manager at the steam sports festival
notes.notes:
To celebrate the Steam Sports Festival and the start of the 2023 Ice Hockey World Championship, we will play our Hockey Manager live! All questions and ideas about the game are welcome!

notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign for our new game Goalgetter
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that the Kickstarter campaign for Goalgetter is out today.
Please support our game, you won't regret it!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thomasschreiber/goalgetter-torschutzenkonig]
Visit Kickstarter campaign![/url]

The Kickstarter campaign features - beside the game - exclusive products such as autographs, posters, footballs, jerseys, and trophies all signed by Ailton.
 
The campaign has set modest EUR 20,000 as funding goal and offers very attractive bonuses for reaching stretch goals. From EUR 100,000 all DLC for the game will be free. With higher financing amounts, even games up to a value of EUR 80 could be free.

We hope to motivate football manager fans with our idea of simulating a football player's career, to support our game. If you are quick, you will receive fantastic special offers as an "early bird".

Many thanks for your support!
